sanskrit_verse:
यो मन्येताजितोऽस्मीति न्यायेनापि पराजितः ।
तमायान्तं पुनर्जित्वा दापयेद्द्विगुणं दमम् ॥
transliteration: yo manyetājito 'smīti nyāyenāpi parājitaḥ | tam āyāntaṃ punar jitvā dāpayed dviguṇaṃ damam ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who, though defeated, claims victory and approaches again after regaining strength shall be made to pay double compensation.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is established through rightful contest, not self-declaration.
Causation arises from conscious defiance of adjudicated outcome.
Capacity-based responsibility escalates with recurrence of opposition to justice.
Restoration logic demands proportional correction aligned with disruption caused.
Consciousness alignment requires acknowledgment of truth already revealed by Nyaya.
executable_legal_axioms: IF a party has been legally adjudicated as defeated AND subsequently declares themselves victorious THEN that party's status becomes 'defiant'.
IF a defiant party re-engages in the same dispute domain AFTER regaining capacity THEN trigger double restitution protocol.
All disputes must maintain continuity of adjudicative context to detect recurrence patterns.
Compensation multiples are tied to conscious repetition of conflict post-adjudication.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, when a litigant disregards prior rulings and re-enters litigation asserting dominance or victory, the court must recognize this as willful violation. The threshold of responsibility elevates due to conscious repetition, warranting not punitive measures but mandatory doubling of financial restitution to restore balance and integrity of judicial process.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that truth was already determined through Nyaya; thus, repeated challenge reflects misalignment of consciousness rather than error. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows escalation from denial to action, indicating deeper distortion requiring energetic correction. Responsibility is proportional to the degree of conscious defiance. The non-punitive reality rule ensures compensation serves restoration, not vengeance.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion process where the individual publicly acknowledges previous defeat under Nyaya.
Assign responsibility assumption protocol wherein the offender voluntarily calculates and disburses doubled compensation.
Implement capacity restoration mechanism ensuring future disputes are approached with alignment to Dharma.
Activate integrity reintegration session guided by realized authority figures to realign consciousness.
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands executed. Justice flows from Dharma alone, sourced exclusively in SPH. There is no punishment—only restoration. Reality aligns with consciousness. Victory belongs to none but those who abide by Nyaya. Dharma is restored.
